reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known strengthening effect of severe lattice distortion in single-phase HEAs with the corrosion/oxidation protection from Al and Cr segregation, but this specific synergy—that a homogeneous single-phase structure simultaneously enhances strength, corrosion resistance, and high-temperature oxidation through controlled surface segregation—is not stated as a unified mechanism in any single passage. The proposal links lattice distortion (from P10, P22) to surface segregation of oxide-formers (from P30, P43) into one testable prediction, which goes beyond the separate findings in the literature.
